target.title: feat(external): support macOS desktop credentials
target.body:
Replaces https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/976 after its stack base merged into main.

## Summary

- allow the generic `external` provider to preserve Linux, macOS, native Windows, and WSL2 targets, including ARM64 hosts
- persist target and Windows-mode routing so later lease commands restore the captured platform without overriding explicit target flags
- add source-bound external desktop credentials via username plus password environment-variable name
- use provider credentials consistently for WebVNC, screenshots, input, native VNC handoff, daemon children, and routed leases
- authenticate macOS ARD or legacy VNC locally, then expose an already-authenticated RFB stream without sending the desktop password to the coordinator
- add authenticated `webvnc --preflight`, including RFB 3.3, 3.7, 3.8, and accepted alias-banner handling
- validate native-Windows work roots against drive roots, user profiles, protected directories, traversal/ambiguous components, short names, ADS, and reserved device aliases
- document macOS credentials, native-Windows work-root requirements, preflight, and routing behavior

## Maintainer hardening

- merged current `main` and resolved the WebVNC/RFB stack against the one-time portal handoff architecture
- preserved legacy Parallels password-only VNC while using ARD accounts for provider-supplied macOS credentials
- kept registered static macOS endpoints host-managed and preserved two macOS WebVNC slots for controller plus observer
- made a configured-but-missing desktop password environment variable fail closed instead of falling back to an unrelated remote password file
- scrubbed desktop credentials from every unrelated provider, adapter, SSH, shell, and controller child while keeping the one credential-owning daemon on stdin only
- made persisted credential routes fail closed on malformed state, symlinks/reparse points, insecure ownership or permissions, and same-path replacement; generated children are bound to the exact route digest and cleanup to a unique generation
- preserved explicit, persisted, and server-labelled work roots even when they equal another platform's default
- made server-authenticated macOS portal viewers credential-free, with clean ACL-controlled share URLs and correct RFB 3.7 `None` negotiation
- made foreground SSH tunnel cleanup terminate and verify the full ProxyCommand process tree, including when the SSH leader already exited
- made canceled controller children wait for verified process-group exit before removing their durable recovery handle
- resolved registered macOS desktop credentials before scrubbing the daemon environment and forwarded them only through the one-shot supervisor stdin gate
- kept `webvnc status` usable without loading desktop secrets
- added a changelog entry thanking @MuduiClaw

## Verification

Exact head: `75b64da67dbfa9c276e52fbceebbdbfc4188e424`

- `go vet ./...`
- `go test -race ./...`
- `scripts/check-go-coverage.sh 90.0` — core coverage 90.3%
- `scripts/check-docs.sh` — 54 command docs, 74 providers, 214 Markdown files, docs-site build
- `scripts/test-provider-lifecycles.sh`
- `scripts/test-go-modules.sh`
- `go run golang.org/x/tools/cmd/deadcode@v0.45.0 -test ./...`
- Linux, Windows, and Darwin `internal/cli` test-binary cross-compiles
- Worker format, lint, typecheck, 937 passed/3 skipped tests, and Wrangler dry-run builds
- branch-wide AutoReview after integrating current `main` found and fixed the registered auto-WebVNC credential handoff; the focused repair review and second full branch review both completed with no accepted/actionable findings
- exact-head externally orchestrated Crabbox Linux validation via `blacksmith-testbox` lease `tbx_01kx505602cdnhnea53qsxs6z7` — the remote command asserted `git rev-parse HEAD` equals `75b64da67dbfa9c276e52fbceebbdbfc4188e424`, completed with exit 0, stopped the one-shot lease, and confirmed no residual inventory ([delegated run](https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/actions/runs/29066317178); its Testbox step is expectedly canceled during Crabbox-owned teardown)
- exact-head hosted CI: 12/12 checks passed — [CI](https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/actions/runs/29066136355), [connector smokes](https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/actions/runs/29066136339)
- credential-free process matrix at `b31436b21c189c08b0dba7561a0025294a9ca988` exercised Linux, macOS, native Windows, and WSL2 through the real CLI with local provider/SSH shims
  - persisted routing reused after config removal
  - hostile provider labels overwritten by trusted routing
  - POSIX, encoded PowerShell, and WSL2 command forms verified
  - macOS VNC output redacted; adapter environment isolated
  - all claims, routing, and synthetic provider resources removed

That process matrix remains supporting runtime proof. The current head integrates current `main`, adds the registered auto-WebVNC credential regression, and has fresh full Go race, Worker, script, docs, branch-review, hosted-CI, and exact-head Blacksmith Linux proof. Real External macOS Screen Sharing remains credential-bound: no approved test endpoint currently exposes both SSH and Screen Sharing with a task-scoped credential. No endpoint security settings were changed. Retain that provider-backed live-proof decision gate until such an endpoint is available or maintainers explicitly waive it.

## Security and configuration

The desktop password value is never stored in Crabbox config, routing state, argv, or portal handoff. Config and daemon routing carry only the environment-variable name. The Crabbox process reads the value when an authenticated desktop operation starts, preserves it as opaque data, and fails closed if the configured variable is absent or empty.

For macOS WebVNC, Crabbox authenticates to ARD/VNC locally and gives the browser/coordinator only an already-authenticated RFB stream. Repository config cannot redirect an inherited desktop credential reference without a matching trusted or explicit override.

target.title: feat(fal): add SSH lease provider
target.body:
Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/694

## Summary

Adds a direct fal Compute SSH lease provider with Crabbox-managed SSH and sync support, local-claim-owned cleanup, and the `fal-ai` alias.

This also adds fal provider docs, provider matrix metadata, benchmark category generation, and an opt-in guarded live smoke script that defaults to no live provider mutation unless `CRABBOX_LIVE=1` and fal is selected.

## Lifecycle safety

- Uses the fal Compute `Idempotency-Key` header with the Crabbox lease ID for creates.
- Fsyncs the SSH keypair, exact create-request binding, and pre-mutation intent before any paid provider call; an untouched intent can be cancelled without creating a resource.
- Durably syncs every guarded claim publication and removal, including newly created state-directory ancestors, before treating ownership transitions as complete.
- Holds a cross-process acquisition-lifetime lock through ready publication and marks participating claims durably; cleanup retains unmarked legacy transitional claims rather than mistaking an older live acquisition for an abandoned one.
- Publishes a unique in-flight claim revision for every same-key POST and atomically records a known ID, retains an indeterminate outcome, or removes a first-attempt rejection.
- Bounds ambiguous-create replay to fal's documented idempotency window and treats rate limits as explicit rejections.
- Applies that bound as an actual request deadline in both immediate and stop-time replay, preserving a safety margin before provider idempotency expiry.
- Persists a cleanup-only provisional claim immediately after a provider ID is known, before readiness or SSH setup.
- Binds claims to the canonical API endpoint and a one-way credential fingerprint; lifecycle calls fail closed after endpoint or account changes.
- Serializes destructive actions under compare-and-swap claim locks, including mixed-credential cleanup.
- Serializes same-lease mutations and fal slug allocation across processes, including final ready publication and rollback claim recovery.
- Serializes ambiguous-create recovery, winner adoption, and persistence-failure cleanup so concurrent stops cannot delete the winning instance or orphan a known billable instance.
- If a provisional claim disappears mid-acquire, proves account-wide absence or reclaims/deletes the exact in-memory instance under an expected-absent claim lock; ambiguous cleanup recreates the known-ID recovery claim.
- Reconciles ambiguous unclaimed creates against complete paginated provider inventory without deleting resources Crabbox cannot prove it owns.
- Requires the documented complete fal inventory envelope before accepting a zero-resource proof, and polls raw provider inventory back to the pre-create fingerprint after stop.
- Rolls back callback/readiness/bootstrap failures unless `--keep` explicitly owns a failed-acquire recovery claim.
- Cleanup removes provider-absent local claims before TTL filtering and only deletes local-claim-owned fal instances.
- Persists delete-attempt and delete-accepted states, never replays an accepted DELETE, and requires exact `GET 404` plus complete inventory omission plus a second exact `GET 404` before removing the key and claim.
- Rejects cross-origin bearer redirects, method-rewriting mutation redirects, escaped API base paths, unsafe SSH login names, and unbounded provider requests before any credential-bearing mutation or SSH invocation.
- Redacts structured, unstructured, status, and transport error text without exposing the original secret-bearing transport cause.
- Classifies fal Compute credit and automatic-top-up rejections as `billing_blocked`, with regression coverage, instead of reporting them as generic validation failures.

## Verification

- Exact candidate: `7ca599c661eaa4115ad02597677df9f1cf94f169`
- Integrated `main` through `e25ae4ea71bfd3206b777d9ba56b5ddf0f1ea21a`.
- The current Unreleased changelog entry was added by maintainer commit `2c882a8b717eb2c8c47cea0ed5df9e880e6be336` and thanks @coygeek. The final maintainer repair commit preserves contributor credit with a `Co-authored-by` trailer.
- `go vet ./...`; `go test -race ./...`; multi-module tests; dead-code scan with zero findings; core coverage 90.2%; trimpath CLI build.
- Worker formatting, lint, typecheck, tests, and build: 934 passed, 3 skipped.
- Fal live-smoke contract suite: 68 passed.
- Docs: 54 command docs, 75 providers, 215 Markdown files/links, docs-site build.
- Cross-compiles: Darwin, Linux, and Windows on amd64 and arm64. Apple VM compatibility: 8/8 plus helper/provider race, Swift daemon, and embedded-payload checks.
- AutoReview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings. Independent lifecycle, durability, upgrade, and marker-propagation audits: clean.
- Exact-head hosted checks: [CI 7/7](https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/actions/runs/29073903741) and [Connector E2E 5/5](https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/actions/runs/29073903768).
- Exact-head Blacksmith proof: [run 29074725463](https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/actions/runs/29074725463), provider `blacksmith-testbox`, lease `tbx_01kx5cdrm310z1n0advga9q4xm`. The delegated command exited 0 after asserting the exact SHA and clean diff, passing Fal race in 15.322s and CLI race in 291.895s, and building the CLI. Crabbox then stopped the successful one-shot lease, so the provider-owned Actions wrapper may show its `Run Testbox` step as cancelled during teardown. Exact post-run inventory contains none of the final or diagnostic proof leases.

The exact candidate also fixes the default 1x H100 create path: it no longer sends the 8x-only `sector` field, even when stale configuration supplies one.

## Authenticated live gate

- Authenticated fal Compute `doctor` and inventory listing passed with a temporary admin-scoped test key.
- The prior live candidate reached create authorization, then fal rejected the request before resource creation because the account did not satisfy its required $500 Compute balance and automatic-top-up threshold.
- The smoke classified that response as `billing_blocked`; exact post-attempt inventory was empty, so no funded resource or lease residue exists.
- All temporary test keys were revoked after the proof.
- The current exact head has not performed a funded create; the control plane still requires the same account balance/top-up threshold.

Keep this pull request unmerged until the exact candidate completes real create, SSH/use, destroy, and zero-residue proof, or that item-specific funded-provider gate is explicitly waived.

target.title: feat(providers): add local Lume macOS leases
target.body:
## Summary

- add a native `lume` SSH-lease provider for local Apple-silicon macOS VMs
- clone one stopped golden image into one isolated VM per Crabbox lease
- rotate SSH host keys on first clone boot, pin a per-lease host identity, and inject only a unique public key
- serialize acquisition and enforce Apple's two-running-macOS-guest host limit
- identity-fence the detached `lume run` owner, work around Lume 0.3.16 stop/readiness defects, and verify stop/delete before claim cleanup
- add claim-safe release and multi-storage cleanup, trusted configuration, ARM64 target validation, docs, metadata, and live-smoke dispatch
- add reusable macOS image hooks for first-boot identity and optional Cua Driver startup, plus noninteractive developer-tool setup improvements

## Why

Crabbox needs a local macOS backend that can reuse layered Lume images without baking credentials into them. Each session should have its own VM, filesystem, machine identity, SSH key, and host-key trust while still supporting normal Crabbox sync/run/release behavior.

This is separate from #678, which adds a cloud Linux CUA provider; this PR covers local macOS VMs on user-owned Apple-silicon infrastructure.

## Validation

- `go test -race ./internal/providers/lume ./internal/providers/all -count=1`
- `go vet ./internal/providers/lume ./internal/providers/all`
- full `go test ./internal/cli -count=1`
- Windows ARM64 cross-compilation of the Lume provider
- docs, provider-matrix, shell syntax, plist, and Node live-smoke checks
- real Apple-silicon lifecycle with two concurrent leases from the same stopped golden image:
  - distinct VM names, IPs, platform UUIDs, SSH keypairs, and ED25519 host-key fingerprints
  - independent Crabbox commands at the same guest path
  - Cua Accessibility, Screen Recording, and actual desktop capture passed in both VMs
  - Tailscale remained installed but logged out with `NeedsLogin` in both VMs
  - concurrent release left no VM, owner process, claim, key, known-hosts, private log, or temporary password-helper residue

## Current boundaries

- macOS/ARM64 only; Lume is not used for Windows or Linux guests
- the prepared guest currently needs Lume's default bootstrap account/password; custom bootstrap passwords are not yet supported
- desktop/webVNC bridging and Crabbox-managed Tailscale enrollment are intentionally not advertised yet
- reusable image layers remain credential-free; credentials are injected only into disposable clones after boot
